ALL OFWs IN TAI PO SAFE AND ACCOUNTED FOR

UPDATE: Ninety-two Filipinos are confirmed to be safe and accounted for after the fatal fire incident in Tai Po district, the Philippine Consulate General in Hong Kong said on Tuesday, Dec. 2. 

The consulate says the two overseas Filipino workers who were listed for verification were found to be in the Philippines when the fire broke out in the Wang Fuk Court apartment complex last Nov. 26. 

One injured OFW remains in the hospital.

🌀 #WilmaPH / #Nokaen Update
Issued: Tuesday, December 2, 2025 
– 4:00 PM Philippine Time

TROPICAL disturbance #93W / #Invest93W in the West Pacific Ocean basin is currently moving northwest at 15 km/h, and is expected to begin a turn toward the southwest on Wednesday, December 3, 2025. As this turn begins, a TROPICAL DEPRESSION is likely to form within the next 24 hours as the system tracks toward the #EasternVisayas and the #Bicol region of #Mindanao, #Philippines.

All residents and friends in these regions should be closely monitoring this system, making immediate preparations, identifying safe shelter, and evacuating coastal areas as necessary. 93W is expected to strengthen into TROPICAL STORM #Wilma / #TropicalStormWilmaPH / #TropicalStormNokaen, bringing the following hazards:

Torrential TROPICAL rain squalls

Winds of 85–110 kph

Dangerous seas, surf, and coastal flooding

Life-threatening flash flooding across both inland & island communities

Serious infrastructure damage, including flooded homes (potentially up to rooftops) and washed-out roads

Please continue to monitor official PAGASA updates and follow the Hurricane/Typhoon/Cyclone Updates & Information page for 24/7 coverage.

Respectfully,

Roshin

🎉 Fooditual Global Food Showcase Contest – Winners Announcement

Hello everyone! Thank you for participating in our first Fooditual Global Food Showcase Contest. We were amazed by your creativity and the delicious dishes shared from around the world. After careful review, we’re thrilled to announce our winners:

🏆 Best Food Photography Winners

@saeedeh0361 – Iran (Koofteh Tabrizi)🇮🇷
• Beautifully captured the rustic, homemade essence of this traditional Iranian dish
• Warm lighting and composition made us feel like we were sitting at a family table in Tabriz
• Showcased the herbs and textures in a way that really brought the dish to life

@ccrriiy – South Korea (Tteokbokki)🇰🇷
•Perfectly showcased the glossy, vibrant red sauce coating the rice cakes
•Styling, toppings, and framing made the dish visually striking and appetizing
•We could almost taste the sweet spicy flavor just by looking

🏆 Most Unique Food Entry Winners

@Jackpham97 – Vietnam (Bun Cha)🇻🇳
•Stood out for rich storytelling and cultural depth
•Explained the charcoal-grilled technique and shared interesting cultural context (like the Obama connection)
•Detailed flavor breakdown and authentic grilling photo added a full culinary experience

@_0xgetsumei – Philippines (Buko Halo-Halo)🇵🇭
•Highly creative presentation: halo-halo served inside a fresh coconut
•Vivid description of the “colorful mountain” of ingredients and textures
•Tropical, inventive, and uniquely Filipino an edible work of art

🎁 What’s Next
•Each winner will be featured on the Fooditual community main page for one week
•Each winner will be pinned in the Ritual Discord food category

Thank you again to everyone who participated. Every entry brought something special to the table, and we loved learning about food cultures from around the world. Keep sharing, keep cooking, and keep celebrating the universal language of food!

— The Fooditual Team💚
